name: Hotel Vindhu Vihar Family Restaurant
why_it_matters: The best-reviewed sit-down restaurant in Medak town — Tripadvisor ranks it #1 of the handful of Medak restaurants, rated 4.3. In a small district town with very few proper dining options, Vindhu Vihar is the dependable family-meal address for visitors to the Medak Cathedral and Medak Fort.
insider_tip: Medak has only a few real restaurants — Vindhu Vihar is the safe sit-down choice for a full meal between the Cathedral and the Fort. Order the biryani or a Telangana-style meal. Walk-in; busiest at lunch on weekends.

name: Swagath Mess & Family Restaurant
why_it_matters: Medak's central budget biryani-and-mess address, right opposite the bus depot and close to the Cathedral. Long-established and well-known locally for value-for-money meals — the convenient quick-meal stop for travellers arriving by bus before heading to Medak's sights.
insider_tip: The mutton biryani is the dish regulars rate; the place gets crowded and oily-spicy at peak, so come slightly off-lunch. Its position opposite the bus depot makes it the natural arrival or departure meal. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Opposite Bus Depot, near Medak Church, Medak town, Medak District, Telangana 502110

name: Sri Hamsa Restaurant
why_it_matters: One of the small set of verified restaurants in Medak town — a casual Indian eatery listed on Tripadvisor with an active Facebook presence. In a town this thin on dining, Sri Hamsa is a genuine alternative to the bus-depot mess for a quieter sit-down meal.
insider_tip: A reasonable second choice when Vindhu Vihar is full. Standard South and North Indian menu — meals, biryani and tiffins. Walk-in only; confirm timings as a small-town kitchen can vary.
